notes: IKE header at offset 42 (eth14+ip20+udp8): random 8B initiator SPI, 8B zero responder SPI, next_payload 0 (empty payloads), version 0x20, exchangetype 34 (SA_INIT), flags 0x08 (initiator), msgid 0, length 28

SPI is run-random (math/rand seeded by time) -> nonzero assert; responder SPI is 8 zero bytes -> exact value assert (tshark prints plain 0000000000000000)
dst 500 avoids the udpencap/Non-ESP path (planner: only dst 4500 gets the marker); udp.port 500 is IANA-registered to isakmp so no decode_as needed
